cycle_position.summary: Post-boom hangover: vacancy 23.1% nationally after ~60M SF delivered 2020-2025 in the 11 tracked hubs (more than half still vacant), rents deflating. The bleeding has likely peaked — construction pipeline down to 4% of inventory (lowest since 2017), funding stabilizing, clinical-trial activity strengthening — but recovery is a multi-year absorption story.

cap_rate_ranges.note: Trades are distress-driven and bespoke; no meaningful 2026 band.

supply_demand.value: 23.1% vacancy; pipeline 4% of inventory and shrinking.

debt_terms.value: Institutional; lenders largely closed to new lab exposure.

small_investor_verdict.entry_vehicle: None at $1-2M. Watch from a distance; the eventual distressed-conversion trade belongs to institutions.
small_investor_verdict.reasoning: Specialized systems (HVAC, vibration, chemical), institutional tenancy, and a 23% vacancy overhang — nothing here fits a small hands-on buyer.
